name: Scarwood
description: The wood on Jamuraa containing the Dark Heart of the Wood, which the tiger warriors were made to guard.

description_citations.text: "Terrent Amese". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terrent Amese fuses man and tiger to create the first tribe of tiger warriors to guard the Dark Heart of the Wood.
timeline.quote: who created the first tribe of Jamuraan tiger warriors by fusing the essence of man and tiger.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojanen realizes his people are slave labor and Terrent Amese no god, and rallies the tribe to seek independence.
timeline.quote: He rallied his tribe behind him and tried to obtain their independence from their creator.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit rediscovers the tribes' origins, and the four tribes make peace, return to Scarwood, rebuild the Tabernacle and found an empire.
timeline.quote: The four tribes would end up making peace with one another

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit is visited by a cat ghost and the party helps the half-elves of Scarwood against giant apes.
timeline.quote: Jedit and the others help the elves against the apes

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terrent Amese creates the first cat warriors to protect the Dark Heart, who build the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale.
timeline.quote: Terrent Amese created the first cat warriors by fusing the essence of man and tiger

citation.text: "Scarwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the exodus of the cat warriors, the Scarwood elves claim the forest and fend off tiger-warrior descendants.
timeline.quote: the Scarwood elves would claim the forest as their own

citation.text: "Scarwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A tribe of sapient apes displaces the elves.
timeline.quote: the elves in turn were displaced by a tribe of sapient apes

citation.text: "Scarwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit convinces the four cat warrior tribes that Terrent Amese was not a god and negotiates safe passage through the Scarwood.
timeline.quote: Jedit was able to negotiate safe passage through the Scarwood for any cat warrior

citation.text: "Scarwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After being abandoned by Terrent Amese and his creations, the Scarwood tabernacle falls into ruin for over 900 years.
timeline.quote: After being abandoned by both Terrent Amese and his creations, the tabernacle fell into ruin for over 900 years

citation.text: "Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale", section "Scarwood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Johan's War, Jedit Ojanen and his cat warrior followers rebuild the tabernacle.
timeline.quote: it was rebuilt by Jedit Ojanen and his cat warrior followers

citation.text: "Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale", section "Scarwood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terrent Amese creates Ur-Drago by merging a tortoise, a white-maned horse and a black bull to punish Ojanen's people.
timeline.quote: was created by the planeswalker Terrent Amese around 2600 AR

citation.text: "Ur-Drago", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
